title: A Cipher for the Extraction
author: Theo Voss
blurb: Mirabel Marchetti, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
